_comment: Chunk 1 of 4 in a 20-epoch run (5 epochs each) on a 660-image stratified C3VD subset (all 17 sequences), targeting ~3.6 hours total on CPU. Starts fresh from the original v_tau050 checkpoint (adjust_net freshly initialized) -- this matches the original recipe's full 20-epoch budget, just on fewer images, for time feasibility. Each subsequent chunk resumes from the previous chunk's final checkpoint under a new model_name (self.epoch resets to 0 each process invocation, so reusing model_name across chunks would overwrite/mislabel earlier epochs).
